question.problem:
The triangle $\mathcal{T}$ is mapped to the triangle $\mathcal{T'}$ under the action of a reflection. What is the equation of the line of reflection?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14222660/assets/1de75f303ced7cfba310e4ef05a964453f7ffd279a9dec0050e9026b58a02ce7.png)
question.worked_solution:
The line of reflection is the perpendicular bisector of the segments joining each point to its image. 

Therefore, the line of reflection is $x = \dfrac{1}{2},$ as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14222660/assets/29eefc4587dbf48f003f351138d4ec2eaea36e2618c831348e4578ff32782ee8.png)
